sources.title: An Interview with OpenAI President Greg Brockman About Astra and Alignment
sources.quote_checked: human judgment, human oversight, human control, all of those things are absolutely critical to maintain | we're taking these step by step in terms of pacing | We are all moving to being these higher-level managers, these directors | I would view this as a continuous process of how the product rolls out in order to help harness this capability

sources.title: Greg Brockman
sources.quote_checked: I think the most important decision we've made in OpenAI's history was the decision to do iterative deployment | What you want to do is 10x the output of the company | I'll observe that Anthropic and us are pursuing very similar strategies

sources.title: Greg Brockman quits OpenAI after abrupt firing of Sam Altman
sources.quote_checked: But based on today's news, I quit. | I continue to believe in the mission of creating safe AGI that benefits all of humanity.

sources.title: Greg Brockman consolidates OpenAI's product teams to build an "agentic future"
